# Who may change which path during P0 and P1. One rule per line: <glob> <owner>. The first matching rule wins.
# Owners: a = stream A (platform and ingestion side), b = stream B (application and serving side),
#         shared = either stream, append-only, in a PR of its own, main = main session (design and coordination).
# Globs are anchored at the repository root (*.md is a root file only): * stays inside one directory, ** crosses
# directories. A path that matches no rule fails the check, so add a rule here first (main session). A PR from branch
# a/* or b/* may touch only its own paths and shared paths (check: scripts/check-ownership.py, job ownership in
# verify.yml).
# Work queues: plans/work/ (each stream owns its queue and results file). History: plans/archive/p0, p1, p1b.

# Stream queues and results
plans/work/stream-a.md                        a
plans/work/results-a.md                       a
plans/work/stream-b.md                        b
plans/work/results-b.md                       b
